commits.message:
feat: automatic job lifecycle with heartbeat, reconcile and notifications

Implement the Python-side lifecycle so a Factory issue runs end-to-end
without manual Termius operations:

- factory lifecycle: heartbeats live workers and reconciles dead ones to a
  terminal state (exit 0 -> completed, non-zero -> failed, unknown exit ->
  failed with an explicit reconcile error; a dead PID never stays running).
- factory heartbeat/complete/fail: idempotent lifecycle commands that fill
  finished_at, duration_seconds and exit_code.
- notify: integration with the factory-notify CLI contract
  (FACTORY_NOTIFY_ENABLED/CMD/CWD/TIMEOUT); provider failures never crash or
  change the job outcome.
- Reconciliation and notifications are idempotent: a second pass never
  duplicates a transition or a notification.

Tests: 44 new tests covering live heartbeat, exit-0 completion, non-zero
failure, dead-PID reconciliation, idempotency and notification events.
commits.display_title: feat: automatic job lifecycle with heartbeat, reconcile and notifications

commits.message:
Factory Web V2 Phase 1: admin login + credential entry form (#3)

* feat: read Pomerode's multi-account capacity schema, add reusable notify script

ops_metrics.capacity_providers_summary() now reads capacity_providers.json's
accounts[] list (Pomerode grew multi-account support so several people's keys
for the same provider can coexist) instead of assuming one flat status per
provider -- rolls up capacity_added across every READY account, tagged by
owner.

Also adds scripts/notify_email.py: generalizes the ad-hoc Resend-via-vault
email script this session kept hand-writing (blocker notifications, signup
checklists) into one reusable CLI, per the standing "notify blockers by
email" preference. Documents the Cloudflare-403 gotcha (needs a real
User-Agent header) inline so it doesn't get rediscovered next time.

* feat: Factory Web V2 Phase 1 -- admin login + credential entry form

Adds /admin/* routes so Thiago can type a new vault secret into a real
form instead of pasting it in chat/terminal, per docs/web-v2-credentials-
and-chat.md. Phase 1 only (credential entry) -- chat (Phase 2) is
explicitly out of scope.

- admin_auth.py: single-operator login ported from mybagcenter-site's
  apps/storefront/lib/admin-auth.ts (hmac.compare_digest password check,
  HMAC-signed admin_session cookie so the cookie never carries the
  password itself). Password + signing secret both live in the vault
  (FACTORY_WEB_ADMIN_PASSWORD, FACTORY_WEB_AUTH_SECRET), never hardcoded.
- require_admin dependency guards every new route except the login form.
- GET /admin/secrets lists names/metadata via vault.list_secrets (never
  decrypts). GET+POST /admin/secrets/new writes straight through to
  vault.set_secret (same function/audit log as `factory secret set`),
  never logs/echoes/caches the submitted value.
- CSRF: Origin/Referer header checked against request host on both POSTs,
  fail-closed when both are absent (single-trusted-user model, not a full
  CSRF token system per the spec).
- Cookie defaults to non-secure (FACTORY_WEB_COOKIE_SECURE=1 to flip on)
  because the VPS has no TLS in front yet -- a `secure` cookie would be
  silently dropped over the current plain-HTTP/SSH-tunnel setup.
- V1 (dashboard, /api/*, /healthz, /metrics) is untouched: still GET-only,
  unauthenticated, verified by the full existing test_web.py suite passing
  unchanged.
- README's "Factory Web V1" section updated: new /admin/* endpoint table,
  setup instructions for the two vault secrets, and an explicit TLS
  warning (SSH tunnel/localhost only until Caddy is in front).

24 new tests in tests/test_web_admin.py covering: correct/wrong password,
cookie forgery/tampering, require_admin on every guarded route, secret
value never leaking into responses/logs/audit log, invalid name handling,
and CSRF rejection of cross-origin POSTs. Full suite: 353 passed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
